summary: Scanned src/ (7 projects, ~58 C# files) and tests/. Overall shape is clean; the consumer pipeline carries most of the small opportunities.

findings.title: Avoid re-materializing the rate window list on every squeak
findings.detail: The window is rebuilt with Where().ToList() on every event, allocating a new list on the hot consumer path. A Queue with head-trimming does the same cutoff work without per-event allocation.
findings.suggestion: Keep a Queue<SqueakEntry> and dequeue while Peek().Timestamp <= cutoff.

findings.title: Unify hostile-transport wrappers as IEventBus decorators
findings.detail: Both hostile wrappers re-implement the same delegating shape around IEventBus with copy-pasted forwarding. A shared decorator base would make each wrapper a single override and make composing hostility modes explicit.

proposed_issues.title: Extract a delegating EventBusDecorator base
proposed_issues.body:
## Motivation
DuplicatingBus and ReorderingBus repeat the same IEventBus forwarding.

## Scope
Add an abstract decorator that forwards all IEventBus members; no behavior change.

## Acceptance
Existing kernel tests pass unchanged.

proposed_issues.title: Port DuplicatingBus and ReorderingBus onto the decorator base
proposed_issues.body:
## Motivation
Remove the duplicated forwarding once the base exists.

## Scope
Each wrapper overrides only the member it perturbs.

## Acceptance
Hostile-transport demo (/mis-demo) behaves identically.

notes: LogTailFeeder's polling loop could use PeriodicTimer, but the current Task.Delay is equally clear — not worth a finding.
